description: Description meta handling. A supplied description is HTML-escaped (double quotes become ", < and > become entities) before being rendered into the description meta tag, protecting against markup injection while leaving non-ASCII letters intact. Passing a boolean false suppresses the description entirely so no description tag is emitted.

cases.expected_output: <title>It's Over 9000!</title><meta name="description" content="de fidélisation des salariés">
